answer: The relic debit happens at intake, karst totals the burned amount, and jetty anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm thus forfeits the burn once for each extra identity on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 15 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. Each copy needs 7 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
